name: subgrade stress
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 路基内部因荷载作用产生的单位面积内力。

complete_examples.text: It is shown that the dynamic results such as the wheel-rail forces, subgrade stress and its attenuation pattern obtained by this model agree well with those derived by classical methods; track geometrical status possess significant influence on system vibrations, with the deterioration of track ge ometries, all system responses will be inevitably increased by different extent; and this model provides possibility of analyzing the performance of track-subgrade systems subject to moving vehicles from aspects of system dynamics.

For instance, Figs. 13, 14 and 15 respectively show the variation of subgrade vertical acceleration, lateral acceleration and subgrade stress of specific point at the surface layer under time steps from 0.001 s to 0.02 s with increment of 0.001 s. It can be observed from these three figures the subgrade surficial responses corresponding to various time steps can be solved and ob tained with stability and accurateness at time domain.
